epics.title: Password Reset
epics.description: Allow users to reset their password

user_stories.title: Password Reset
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to reset my password, so that I can regain access to my account.

acceptance_criteria.given: The user has an existing account and wants to reset their password
acceptance_criteria.when: The user initiates the password reset process and provides a new password
acceptance_criteria.then: The system updates the password and the user can log in with the new password

test_cases.title: Successful password reset and login with new password
test_cases.precondition: User has an existing account and is not logged in.
steps: Initiate the password reset process for the existing account.
Provide a new password as required by the process.
Attempt to log in using the account with the newly set password.
test_cases.expected_result: The system updates the password and the user is able to log in successfully with the new password.
